The Lux REPL uses the self-hosted compiler through the effect pipeline.
Three modes demonstrate the meta-unification live:

  lux> 2 + 3
  5
  lux> :teach
  → teaching mode
  lux> 2 + 3
  [teach] 4 tokens
  [teach] 1 AST nodes
  [teach] compiled
  5
  lux> :trace

  [trace] ("chunk", [1, 2, 1, 3, 30, 72], [], [])
  5

two-top/43a6edf:
The script wrote its awk scratch buffer to a hardcoded
/tmp/diagnose_desync_$$.out, which fails with EDQUOT on machines
where /tmp is a quota-bounded tmpfs (caught locally by the existing
identical_tsvs_succeed / first_divergence_is_reported / e2e
perturbed_replay_diagnose_pipeline integration tests when /tmp
saturates).

Switched to mktemp + EXIT trap. mktemp honors $TMPDIR automatically,
so callers can redirect scratch into any roomier filesystem
(e.g. TMPDIR=$PWD/target/test_tmp); CI's /tmp on GitHub-hosted
runners is unaffected since mktemp falls back to /tmp when $TMPDIR
is unset.

The trap also collapses the two explicit cleanup calls in the
empty-output and divergence-found branches into a single guaranteed
on-exit cleanup, which would have leaked a scratch file on any
future early exit.
perennials/43ca662:
The Place tray came from her kept list and nowhere else, which quietly made
Keep a prerequisite of placing: standing over the sheet with a plant in
mind, she had to leave the yard, find it in the guide, press Keep, and come
back to a tray it had finally joined. Keeping was never a requirement of
placing; it was only ever the tray's source.

Now it is the tray's default instead. A find box in Place mode searches the
same index the omnibox reads, common-name synonyms included, so "mouse
melon" places Melothria scabra here exactly as it finds it there; the top
matches wear the same pills the kept tray wears, and arming and placing are
unchanged. With the box empty the kept tray is back, because a shortlist
she built on the porch is still the right thing to reach for first.

The empty state stops asking her to go keep something. It says the truer
thing: type a name and any plant in the guide places, and kept plants wait
here as a tray.
